description: Void an issued invoice and clone it into a new editable Draft (void + reissue). The original is voided and retained for audit; the new Draft can be edited then re-issued. The void is IRREVERSIBLE. Call once with no token to preview; re-call with the returned confirm_token and an idempotency_key to commit.

confirm_token.description: Token returned by the preview (call this tool once with no token to get it). Required to commit; expires in ~10 minutes.

idempotency_key.description: Required when committing (confirm_token present): retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

invoice_id.description: Id of the issued invoice to void and reissue as a new Draft.

name: reissue_invoice
